goal: Select a creative direction that lets a time-poor board decide between costed options from a read-ahead pack and a 15-minute presentation.

candidates.name: Evidence-led
candidates.rationale: Board priorities are capital discipline and headcount; every slide must carry a costed exhibit. Read-ahead use means exhibits must be self-explaining.

candidates.name: Future-state
candidates.conditions: Re-enter when the deck's purpose is to persuade a sales or programme audience rather than to decide capital allocation.

candidates.name: Human-centred
candidates.rationale: No stakeholder research in the content model; the direction would require evidence that does not exist.

manifest.assumption: Audience is a time-poor board deciding capital allocation
Pack is read unattended before the meeting
Board is unfamiliar with automation technology
Every option must be shown without a recommended winner
